name: SeasonsRewardsU8
aliases: one-byte element of the u8 set
summary: One element of a SeasonsRewards byte set: a single raw byte. The client reads and writes it through its raw one-byte stream slot, so the element is one u8 with no structure of its own.
purpose: Give the byte set a named element card so the container is counted(nested(...)) and the generated struct never declares a bare Vec<u8>.

fields.name: value
fields.note: Read and written with the client's raw one-byte stream slot (reader 0x14087a330), inside the 0x14279f4f0 element loop. Measured 0x00 in cardTemplate and 0x08 in stampedSquares; the byte's meaning is unnamed.
